comparison.lead: Traditional OSB-based SIPs are an improvement on stick framing — but they still require external cladding, extra trades, and additional finishing. Panelspan® arrives ready to install and ready to paint.
comparison.panelspanImageAlt: Panelspan® panel layers — 10mm MagnaClad (MgO) external face, EPS-FR core, 10mm MagnaLiner (MgO) internal face

heroLead: MagnaClad, our own 10mm MgO board, bonded to a high-density EPS core as standard. No external cladding required — just lock the panels together and reach lock-up in days.
overviewPara1: Panelspan® structural insulated wall panels combine a high-density EPS core with magnesium oxide (MgO) faces: 10mm MagnaClad with a shiplap edge outside and 10mm MagnaLiner inside as standard — eliminating the need for separate cladding, sarking, or internal lining trades.
overviewPara2: Each panel interlocks precisely on site, creating a fully insulated, structurally strong wall in a fraction of the time of traditional framing. Available in three systems: Steel Skin, FC/FC and MgO/MgO.
overviewPara3: Engineered for Australian climate conditions, Panelspan® walls resist moisture, bushfire, and extreme temperature variations — delivering a superior thermal envelope that supports 8-Star NatHERS ratings.

panelOptions.name: Fibre Cement Panel
panelOptions.copy: High-density EPS core with ready-to-paint FC faces both sides. Moisture stable, no warping, ideal for residential and commercial applications.

panelOptions.name: Magnesium Oxide Panel
panelOptions.copy: Premium MgO faces deliver superior fire resistance, moisture stability, and acoustic performance. The choice for high-specification builds.
